blocks.text: SOHO — Rooftop Living in the Heart of Grandview Surrey

parts.t: SOHO

is a community of 170 contemporary townhomes by Zenterra Developments at 16315–16337 23A Avenue in Grandview Surrey. Zenterra built SOHO after its Hyde Park community, and SOHO's defining feature is a private rooftop deck with a gas hookup, with views of the North Shore Mountains and the ocean from select units.
Floor plans range from two to four bedrooms, and some units have side-by-side garages.
Many plans have a main floor that flows between the kitchen, dining and living areas with a powder room, and the rooftop deck adds outdoor space above.
Edgewood Elementary and Grandview Heights Secondary catchments (confirm current catchment with the Surrey Schools school locator)
Interiors & Finishes
SOHO kitchens have quartz countertops, KitchenAid stainless steel appliances and soft-close cabinetry, and the living area is anchored by a custom tiled entertainment wall with a fireplace.
Bedroom layouts vary by plan; some two-bedroom plans have an ensuite for each bedroom. Homes have in-suite laundry, and some units have hot water on demand.
The Rooftop Experience

The rooftop deck is SOHO's defining feature. Decks have gas BBQ connections, and select units look toward the North Shore Mountains and the ocean. Deck size varies by plan, so check the listing for the unit you're considering.
For buyers who want outdoor space without a yard to maintain, the rooftop can work as an extra outdoor room for dining and lounging.
Jared Gibbons — Top 1% Fraser Valley Realtor

"At SOHO, I compare units by floor plan, rooftop deck and view, because those vary a lot from one home to the next. If you want to know where the market sits at SOHO right now, I can walk you through active listings and recent sales."
The Neighbourhood
The complex sits on 23A Avenue near 163 Street, a short drive from Grandview Corners, The Shops at Morgan Crossing and the Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre. Also on 23A Avenue,
South Village
is a community of 60 townhomes at 16467 23A Avenue by Red Boutique Properties.
Grandview Heights Sec.
Why SOHO?
SOHO combines a private rooftop deck, Zenterra construction and a clubhouse with a gym, lounge and kids’ play area, on 23A Avenue in Grandview Surrey.
Buyer FAQs
What is the price range for SOHO townhomes in South Surrey?
Prices vary by unit and change with the market. Contact Jared for recent SOHO sales and current listings.
How large are the rooftop patios at SOHO?

Rooftop deck sizes vary by floor plan; check the listing for the unit you're considering. Rooftop decks have gas BBQ hookups, and select units have views toward the North Shore Mountains and the ocean.
Who developed SOHO townhomes in Grandview Surrey?
SOHO was developed by Zenterra Developments, which also built Hyde Park in Grandview Surrey.
Does SOHO South Surrey allow pets?
Pet policies at SOHO are governed by the strata corporation. Always confirm current bylaws with strata management before purchasing, particularly if you have larger dogs or multiple animals.
Does SOHO allow rentals?

Under BC's Strata Property Act amendments effective November 24, 2022, residential strata corporations cannot restrict long-term rentals, so SOHO townhomes can be rented long term. Short-term rentals (such as Airbnb or VRBO) remain subject to strata bylaws and municipal licensing. Buyers should review the current strata bylaws, Form B, and recent strata minutes before purchasing.
How does SOHO compare to Hyde Park in Grandview Surrey?

Both SOHO and Hyde Park were built by Zenterra in Grandview Surrey. SOHO has 170 homes, each with a private rooftop deck, and select units have mountain and ocean views. Hyde Park has 156 homes and the Lancaster Club, a 5,500 sq ft clubhouse. Jared can walk you through a detailed comparison of current availability in both communities.
What amenities does SOHO have?
SOHO has a clubhouse with a gym, a lounge, a kids’ play area and an outdoor playground. The Grandview Heights Aquatic Centre and Morgan Crossing are a short drive away.
